ImageDescription.value: Sabara Srikhetra Jagannath temple is located at a distance of one km from Koraput town. This temple is one of the most popular Jagannatha temples of Odisha, called Sabara Srikhetra. The temple was built in 1972, and since then the temple’s holy Rath Yatra has been celebrated. The local tribal priests have performed all the rituals of Lord Jagannath. at Sabar Srikhetra, all are allowed to take part in worship, regardless of caste, creed, or religion.
